picks.title: AI law startup Norm raises $120M, hits unicorn valuation
picks.why_it_matters: Signals continued strong appetite for vertical AI applications in professional services, validating the AI-for-legal category as a major opportunity for early-stage founders.

picks.title: Hot French startup ZML releases free product to speed inference across lots of AI chips
picks.why_it_matters: Infrastructure plays that reduce AI inference costs create platform shifts—startups building on cheaper inference could unlock new business models previously killed by compute economics.

picks.title: VC firm Chemistry is raising $500M for its second fund
picks.why_it_matters: A new $500M fund from well-pedigreed investors means more dry powder competing for early-stage deals—important signal for understanding the competitive landscape and potential co-investor dynamics.
